summary.text: Diane Napper is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 63 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Zaynab Mohamed (D).
Napper is a self-employed graphic designer.

paragraphs.text: Diane Napper was born in Philadelphia and earned a bachelor's degree from American University in 1989.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, she said she studied international business with a marketing concentration, started Taurus Moon Graphic Design, LLC in 2002, and lives in the Nokomis East neighborhood of Minneapolis.
Napper was the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 63 in 2020, when incumbent Patricia Torres Ray won the general election.
She was also the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 63B in 2024, when incumbent Emma Greenman won.
In the 2020 survey, Napper listed public safety, education and economic opportunities as her key campaign messages.
